readMe: See scripts/checkScreenshotProvenance.mjs. Records are keyed by the SHA-256 of the image bytes, so renaming a file does not move its provenance and replacing the bytes drops the review on the floor. Write records with scripts/capture-guide-evidence.mjs; do not hand-author an appScreenshot record in images.

classes.origin: Blog header cards rendered by scripts/generate-blog-images.py: a 1200x630 brand-coloured slide carrying the post title in the site typefaces plus a per-category line icon. No application UI is drawn, and the generator has no access to any company data. Presence is enforced per post by scripts/checkBlogImages.mjs.
classes.note: A class rule may only cover artwork that is generated, never captured. It cannot cover the screenshot library, and it does not license a file on a screenshot surface: an image classified this way that is published as a picture of the application fails the gate.
